sections.A: Machines zyada tar sirf madadgar hain. Yeh thori der ke liye dard ya sujan kam kar sakti hain taa ke exercise ho sake.
sections.B: Table mein har modality (garmi, barf, TENS, ultrasound, laser, shockwave) ka maqsad, evidence aur safety hai.
sections.C: Machine lagane se pehle: kya saaf maqsad hai, evidence hai, koi contraindication to nahi, aur kya yeh exercise mein madad karegi.
sections.D: Sawaal hal karein. Misaal: TENS gardan ke aage aur bina doctor ki ijazat ke pacemaker par nahi.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
